name: Acceptor Configuration Data Set 7
definition: Data set containing the acceptor parameters of a point of interaction (POI).

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the data set transferred.

SequenceCounter.name: Sequence Counter
SequenceCounter.definition: Counter to identify a single data set within the whole transfer.

LastSequence.name: Last Sequence
LastSequence.definition: Indication of the last sequence in case of split messages.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

POIIdentification.name: POI Identification
POIIdentification.definition: Identification of the point of interactions involved by the configuration data set.

ConfigurationScope.name: Configuration Scope
ConfigurationScope.definition: Scope of the configuration contained in the data set.
